Vill du arbeta med ett av golfens främsta varumärke?

Världens främsta golfspelare förlitar sig på FootJoy, #1 Shoe in Golf. Nu söker vi dig som vill vara en del av teamet och leverera en högklassig kundupplevelse genom våra unika FJ FitLAB-events.



Bli en del av vårt Fitting-team inom Shoe Fitting. Som dedikerad golfare får du möjlighet att representera ett av golfbranschens största och ledande företag. Du kommer att vara FootJoys ansiktet utåt gentemot golfare och återförsäljare och den som står för produktkunskap och kompetens.



Vad är FJ FitLAB?

FootJoy i Norden är en av få regioner i världen som erbjuder FJ FitLAB-events, som är en utprovningsprocess som innefattar en 3D-analys med hjälp utav en skanner för att hitta rätt passform på golfskorna. Utifrån resultatet matchas golfspelarens värden och golfarens personliga preferenserna mot FootJoys breda sortiment av perfomance-skor för golf, som vår Fitting-specialist har med sig.



I rollen som Fitting-specialist kommer du att:

· Genomföra FitLAB-events på golfklubbar av promotion-karaktär.

· Genomföra event och produktutbildningar för konsument.

· Säkerställa kompetens för våra produkter under utbildningar för återförsäljare.

· Stötta våra partners i försäljningen av produkter i samband med eventen

· Skapa kontakt med våra återförsäljare, administrerar och boka upp dina event i samråd med ansvarig säljare på distriktet.

· Representera varumärket FootJoy på ett professionellt sätt vid varje möte med konsumenter, spelare och återförsäljare.





Vem är du?

Som person är du positiv, utåtriktad, driven och en god kommunikatör. Du arbetar är självständigt och det är därför viktigt att du är plikttrogen och ansvarstagande. Vi erbjuder produktutbildning, arbetskläder, bil och konsultarvode. Eget bolag är därför en förutsättning . Vi ser gärna att du talar flytande svenska och engelska. Arbetet är schemalagt och ligger på dagtid, kvällar och helger.





Uppdragets omfattning

Det geografiska området omfattar främst Sverige,  men kan komma att innebära enstaka event i Danmark, Norge och Finland. Du ska vara redo att börja arbeta i slutet på mars med slutdatum den siste augusti. Detta kan komma att ändras beroende på utvecklingen i branschen. Som Fitting-specialist rapporterar du direkt till vår marknadsavdelning.



Frågor och ansökan skickas senast den 7/12 2025 till FootJoy Marketing Manager på filip_morel@acushnetgolf.com. Ansökningar behandlas löpande.



Om Företaget

Acushnet är ett av världens ledande företag inom golfbranschen med varumärken som Titleist, FootJoy, Vokey, Scotty Cameron och Pinnacle. Vi säljer golfbollar, klubbor, kläder, skor och övrig golfutrustning till golfbutiker och golfshopar.

ABOUT THE ROLE



The Junior Marketing Operations Coordinator plays a key role in executing and optimizing email campaigns and marketing automation programs that support Launchmetrics’ nurturing, conversion, and ABM objectives. This role also contributes to maintaining and improving our marketing automation platform and database - identifying challenges, uncovering opportunities for optimization, and implementing solutions to accelerate the contact and account lifecycle.



Reporting to the VP Marketing and working closely with the consultancy operations agency, the Coordinator will support marketing automation and CRM initiatives. This includes enhancing workflows, improving lead generation and nurturing campaigns, setting up and monitoring emails and contributing to the continuous evolution of our marketing processes.

Additionally, the role supports broader marketing operations efforts, including setting up and optimizing landing pages, as well as developing guides, training materials, documentation, and videos to help scale best practices and strengthen the marketing team’s operational excellence.



What you’ll do:



- Support the implementation, optimization, and synchronization of marketing automation, CRM, and lead qualification processes, following guidelines from senior consultants.
- Conceptualize, design and measure email campaigns that support marketing objectives and overall company goals—from copywriting and visual concept development to template creation and performance reporting.
- Stay informed on the latest trends in email design, UX, and copywriting to introduce new formats that enhance email campaign engagement and results.
- Develop a deep understanding of our marketing automation tools, CRM, and analytical systems, including database structure and automated workflows.
- Conduct quality assurance during testing and release phases to ensure smooth and accurate execution of marketing operation processes.
- Assist in optimizing workflows and marketing operations processes to better meet stakeholder needs, including landing page setup in Unbounce or WordPress.
- Support developing reports and dashboards to monitor lead nurturing results across email and database performance.
- Provide transversal support to marketing operations: tools set-up, process coordination, internal documentation development, training, etc.



ABOUT YOU



Who You Are:

- One to two years of experience in digital or email marketing with strong communication skills, someone that knows the impact copywriting can have in driving action, and a solid understanding of processes, data analysis, and the creation of cadences and strategies shaped by buyer behavior.
- Organized and detail-driven with a focus on building and optimizing efficient workflows, tracking performance, and refining strategies.
- Collaborative and proactive team player able to manage multiple projects in a fast paced environment with shifting priorities.

Extra Credit:

- Strong command of English required to collaborate effectively with an international team.
- Tools: Familiarity with marketing automation tools such as HubSpot, Marketo (Adobe) or Pardot (Salesforce).



W e value diverse perspectives and recognize that skills and experiences can be gained in various ways. If you're excited about this opportunity but don't meet every single requirement listed, we would love to hear from you and encourage you to submit an application!

We are a global and highly diverse team – distributed in six different countries, with multiple nationalities and varied expertise – we always work collaboratively to understand each other in a "glocal" way to achieve the best results as one team. The Marketing team works daily on the ideation, production and distribution of campaigns with the objective of attracting the Launchmetrics' target audience.



OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS





WHY YOU’LL LOVE LAUNCHMETRICS



We're a company that prioritizes people, fostering a relaxed yet dynamic atmosphere. Our international team is filled with enthusiastic, motivated individuals who enjoy their work. - Italiano (B2) – opzionale

- Esperienza di almeno 5 anni in ruoli di technical consulting o ambienti di sviluppo.

La tecnologia, coperta da brevetti internazionali e NDA, è pensata per esigenze di mercato reali ed espansive, e il modello sarà replicabile in futuro in altri settori.

Formula di collaborazione

About notus:

Many companies already see the value of personal branding & content, but struggle to:

- come up with the right strategy
- find the time to produce content
- be consistent and play the long-game

That’s why we’re here.

At notus, we build content engines for B2B founders & executives.

We help them leverage the best marketing asset there is - people. (aka personal brands)

We believe that in the future, businesses will thrive on personal brand-led content, so it’s our mission to build an ecosystem of businesses driven by it.

Our roots are in New York City, where our founder, Marvin Sanginés, started documenting his journey starting a marketing agency in 2020.

In the process, he realized that what brought him the most value & opportunities was his personal brand - so he wanted to offer his clients the same.

Fast forward 4 years, and we’ve had the pleasure to work with some of the coolest founders & executives in the game.

From 9-figure entrepreneurs like Noah Kagan and Jesse Puji, to executives of billion-dollar companies like Swisscom and Rhomberg.

notus is young and growing fast.

Our team consists of driven individuals with a love for content, an eye for detail and a whole lot of positive energy.

The copywriter role is very popular because you literally get paid to learn from successful founders & execs every day. (yes, you read that right.)

So, what will you be doing? Let’s take a closer look at the role:

What does a freelance copywriter do at notus?

As a Freelance Copywriter, you'll work closely with our content strategists to turn expert insights into compelling LinkedIn content.

We see this role as a mix of:

- Writer
- Storyteller
- Clear communicator

Here’s how our process works:

Each client project starts with a setup phase, where the content strategist defines the content strategy, optimizes the LinkedIn profile, and sets the media plan.

Once that’s done, we move into the ongoing content engine.

That’s where you come in.

You’ll take transcripts and outlines from client calls and turn them into high-quality posts that:

- reflect the client’s voice
- highlight their expertise
- speak to their target audience
- support their business goals

You’ll collaborate with strategists, follow our editorial process, and deliver clean, on-point drafts on time.

You won’t be left figuring things out on your own.

We’ll provide:

- clear writing frameworks and voice guides
- context and feedback from experienced strategists
- best practices from over 100 personal branding projects

If you write with clarity, care about tone, and know how to craft a good LinkedIn post—this role’s for you.

- you’re a proactive communicator and able to adapt to different personalities
- you have excellent English and German writing & communication skills
- you are highly organized and able to manage many moving pieces
- you possess strong emotional intelligence and empathy
- you’re curious and eager to learn about any topic
- you have excellent copywriting skills
- you have a passion for content
- you are a team player that lifts other people up
- you are skilled at thorough research and understanding
- you are a detailed worker with high standards for quality
- you can take and implement feedback well and without ego

job title: Consultant (12 months, home-based, remotely) Website, Platforms and UX/UI, Individual Giving, PFP, Geneva
description:
- Lead the end-to-end UX/UI process for GGP 2 fundraising platform and Virtual Hub.
- Design and optimize user paths to conversion from landing page to donation confirmation using user-centered methodologies.
- Ensure platform-wide design consistency and alignment with UNICEF’s branding and accessibility standards, as well as adhering to industry-accepted SEO, GEO, and AEO best practices (AI enabled organic discovery engines).

- Plan, execute, and evaluate A/B and multivariate tests on donation flows, CTAs, and content.
- Use tools such as Google Analytics, Hotjar, and Optimizely to generate insights and validate design hypotheses.
- Identify and remove friction points to improve revenue per session, donor engagement, and maximize conversion rates.

- Support the onboarding and roll-out of ecommerce site known as the Global Giving Platform (GGP) 2.0 for UNICEF’s digital fundraising, including UX refinements, testing, and feedback collection.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Product, SES, ICTD, Analytics, Content) to ensure market readiness and smooth transitions.
- Lead the transition from GGP 1.0 to GGP 2.0 for UNICEF’s digital fundraising operation (aka Virtual Hub), covering content migration, data continuity, and process alignment.

- Oversee the front-end performance of existing GGP 1.0 fundraising sites for markets to ensure speed, responsiveness, and reliability.
- Manage website updates and donation form functionality via CMS (e.g., Drupal or other platforms), ensuring integration with payment systems (Stripe) and CRM (Salesforce).
- Monitor platform uptime, performance, and support reporting through tools such as Google Analytics and Power BI.

- Document UX/UI learnings, A/B test results, and platform insights for broader organizational learning.
- Promote a culture of evidence-based design and continuous testing across markets.
- Serve as a UX/UI and experimentation advisor to product, fundraising, and market teams.
- Support the governance process of new feature roll-out, including communicating to UNICEF offices regarding performance analysis and UX and usability testing.

- UX/UI Design for GGP 2.0: Lead UX/UI design for the GGP 2.0 platform across MVP, Core, and Virtual Hub roll-outs. Conduct UX audits, design and refine donor paths to conversion, and ensure consistency with UNICEF’s brand, SEO, and accessibility standards.
- Platform Transition & Business Continuity: Support the phase-out of GGP 1.0 and onboarding of GGP 2.0 in Virtual Hub markets. Ensure continuity of donation flows, website operations, and integrations (CMS, Stripe, Salesforce), while introducing new PSPs such as Checkout etc.
- Experimentation and A/B Testing: Develop and execute a strategic A/B testing roadmap focused on improving conversion rates. Analyze user behavior and continuously optimize key digital elements such as donation forms, CTAs, and layouts.
- Performance Monitoring & Optimization: Ensure high-performing, mobile-responsive websites through regular audits and front-end optimization. Maintain platform uptime, monitor load speeds, and support performance reporting through tools like Power BI.
- Collaboration & Data-Driven Insights: Work closely with Product, Activation (Journeys + Paid media ads), CRM, Analytics, and Content teams to align UX with data insights. Build dashboards, track key KPIs, and personalize donor experience and journeys based on segmentation, test results, and behavioral data.

- Project discovery with key stakeholders (Product, Virtual Hub, ICTD, SES, Data, CRM).
- Conduct a UX/UI audit of existing Virtual Hub user journeys and donation flows.
- Review Virtual Hub tech stack readiness for GGP 2.0, including CMS, PSP, and Salesforce CRM integration.

- Finalize 12-month UX, experimentation, and optimization roadmap aligned with GGP 2.0 milestones.
- Define KPIs and data tracking approach in collaboration with the Data and CRM teams.
- Review and prioritize experimentation backlog for MVP and Core phases of GGP 2.0.
- Support governance process with internal clients (i.e. UNICEF offices using the GGP 2).

- Implement initial UX/UI improvements for GGP 2.0 MVP (e.g., donation flow, SEO/GEO/AEO compatibility, mobile responsiveness).
- Design and align on GGP 2.0 Core user journey templates, wireframes, and conversion elements.
- Develop first version of the performance and business continuity dashboard with Data/CRM teams.

- Support UAT of MVP builds in close coordination with ICTD and Product teams for Virtual Hub.
- Launch A/B testing framework for GGP 2.0 MVP pages and donation forms.
- Integrate user tracking tools (e.g., GA4, Hotjar, Optimizely) and define test measurement approach.

- Implement UX improvements based on early test results and feedback from MVP markets.
- Finalize Core design components and cross-market reusable blocks for Virtual Hub use.
- Expand dashboard to include segmented user behavior, engagement, and CRO tracking.

- Support Core roll-out preparations for Virtual Hub markets, focusing on UX quality and performance.
- Validate integrations (CRM, PSPs) for Core markets and flag issues.
- Prepare usability testing sessions and design validations with selected markets.

- Collaborate with PFP, IT, ICTD, and FinHub teams on integration of new PSPs (e.g., Checkout, Nuvei).
- Support design and optimization of the payment experience across devices.
- Report on PSP UX performance and test conversion impact.

- Analyze UX, A/B testing, and CRO data across MVP and Core releases.
- Refine user journeys and interaction flows based on donor behavior insights.
- Deliver mid-year performance review and adjust UX/testing roadmap accordingly.

- Support the Virtual Hub in phasing out GGP 1.0 websites, ensuring no disruption in fundraising activities.
- Coordinate content migration, URL redirects, and technical decommissioning with ICTD and Product teams.
- Validate that all critical journeys, donation forms, and data flows have been successfully transitioned to GGP 2.0.

- Implement advanced UX techniques (micro-interactions, progress indicators, error recovery, etc.).
- Collaborate with markets to localize and test culturally adapted UX patterns.
- Continue iterative testing based on roadmap and user feedback loops.

- Conduct final rounds of A/B testing on mobile, donation flow, and call-to-action components.
- Run final UX and functionality tests on GGP 2.0 platform across Virtual Hub markets.
- Validate full PSP integrations from donor experience to CRM handoff.

- Deliver final report covering UX/UI optimization efforts, test outcomes, and CRO insights.
- Present final review of the performance dashboard and its use for market reporting.
- Provide recommendations for post-launch UX governance, experimentation, and tech roadmap (GGP 2.0 scaling, PSP performance, CRM insights).

- A first-level university degree (Bachelor's degree or equivalent) in web-design, UX/UI, marketing, computer science, engineering, technology, digital media, or any other relevant areas is required.

- A minimum of two (2) years of progressive experience in web design and development, Strong knowledge of UX/UI design principles, with experience in optimizing websites for conversions or online customer acquisition, and income is required.
- Experience in large scale digital ecommerce non-profit fundraising operations (+5million USD annual revenue) for individuals is an asset.
- Expertise in A/B testing, user behavior analysis, and data-driven experimentation is required.
- Familiarity with CMS platforms (e.g., Optimizely, Drupal) and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) is required.
- Extensive data-crunching experience in Excel and SQL is an asset.
- Proficiency with tools like Google Analytics, Optimizely, Power BI, Hotjar, or similar is an asset.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with internal teams, cross-divisions (ICTD, Communication), multiple cultures, and vendors are required.
- Experience with UN/UNICEF project management is an asset.
- Experience partnering with analytics teams to integrate user research findings and product usage data to better understand the full picture of a user’s experience is an asset.
- A strong working knowledge of user research methods, including when and how to apply different methods in various scenarios, is an asset.
- Experience in managing long-term and multiple projects simultaneously across multiple geographies (please do include the list of geographies you managed in your CV or cover letter) is an asset.
- Experience working under Agile methodology and processes is an asset.

- Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of another official UN language is considered as an asset.
